steps.title: Brief Competitor Analyst
steps.instructions: Describe the competitor, your product and the first-channel decision. Replace the hypothetical founder assumptions with your actual product and URL.
steps.prompt:
Competitor: Granola.

You are the founder building a meeting assistant for small consulting teams, with no audience or marketing budget. This is a hypothetical prelaunch product; there is no public prototype URL to fetch.

Decision: which customer acquisition channel should you copy first? Use only public evidence, label inferences and unknowns, compare the funnel fairly, and finish with 5–10 ranked moves with first steps and numbers to watch.

steps.title: Collect public evidence and write the report
steps.instructions: Build REM from its public source, run doctor and a JSON collection without AI API use, read the harness and channel playbooks, fetch missing public pages, write the teardown and ranked playbook, and check every citation.
